# Copilot instructions

The authoritative instructions for this repository are in **`AGENTS.md`
at the repository root** — this project's own rules first, host-wide
rules in the `host-rules` block at the end. Copilot's cloud agent and
code review read that file directly. This file exists only for the
surfaces that do not: Copilot Chat in the IDE and on github.com.

**Read `AGENTS.md` before making any change.**

The rules below are repeated here because they are the ones that
cause real damage when missed — they are not the whole set.

If you read nothing else:

- **Never `rm` `assets/` or `output/`.** A hook blocks wholesale deletion.
- **Real end-to-end tests must pass `--scene`/`--trace` explicitly** at
  `assets/bicycle.ply` and `assets/bicycle_trace.json` — do not use synthetic
  mock generators for transport validation.
- Keep MoQ transport (`src/moq3dgs/transport/`) decoupled from rendering
  (`src/moq3dgs/render/`).
